items.label: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Company (2026 business plan in the 2025 annual report): it will develop C+L-band

set.signal: Company (2026 business plan in the 2025 annual report): it will develop C+L-band hollow-core fiber and O-band hollow-core fiber jumpers; for AI computing it will focus on three directions - high-efficiency cooling, intelligent power supply and HVDC - developing liquid-cooling control and electrical drive components in-house and laying out key products such as data-center high-efficiency power routers and 800V DC distribution cabinets; facing AI-infrastructure demand it will optimise domestic and overseas plants for fiber and cable, optical modules and liquid-cooling systems and systematically evaluate Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa for new capacity.

items.reason: The plan says the company will 'lay out' (buju) these data-center power products, not launch them; 'launching' overstated a plan as a product launch. The three AI directions are 'focus areas', not things it will 'build'.
items.evidence: 重点围绕高效温控、智能供电、高压直流三大方向，推进液冷智能控制及电气驱动等核心部件自研，布局数据中心高效电能路由器、800V直流配电柜等关键产品
